records.description: A detailed project plan for a beginner's vegetable garden with sections for layout, supplies, and schedule.

sections.heading: Garden Layout
sections.content: Planning a beginner-friendly garden bed of 4ft x 8ft, in a location receiving about 6 hours of sunlight daily. Need to confirm if 6 hours of sunlight is sufficient for most vegetables. Research needed on ideal dimensions for beginner raised bed gardens.

sections.heading: Supplies Needed
sections.content: List of required supplies includes soil, containers or raised bed materials, seeds, basic gardening tools, watering system (considering simple drip irrigation), and potential fencing for pest control (rabbits spotted in neighborhood). Exploring natural pest deterrents as an alternative to chemicals.

sections.heading: Planting Schedule
sections.content: Aim to have everything planted by early May. Specific planting times for each vegetable to be detailed in a separate planting calendar note. Interest in companion planting, such as basil near tomatoes, to be explored.

records.title: Planting Calendar for Vegetable Garden
records.content: A dedicated reference for the planting schedule of vegetables in the beginner's garden, to be referred to throughout the season.
